evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Calvin: 'I'll just run you through some questions and whatnot and get you pricing at the end. It'll probably take about ten minutes or so does that work?' — Framed time-box and promise but moved forward without strongly waiting for explicit yes.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Calvin: 'before we jump in anything in particular that you're concerned about outside of, just kind of a price quote with the move you got coming up.' Customer: 'No, no, just price quote pretty much.' — Asked before probing, customer had no additional concerns.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Calvin: 'as far as I guess total number of boxes you'll have. Do you have kind of idea, idea of how many that would be?... typically we'd see probably like thirty boxes or so, or something like that. Do you think that sounds about right?' — Box count anchor offered with typical range.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Calvin: 'typically for a home this size it's four guys for about you know, six to eight hours but I would definitely cut that in half... at 208 an hour, you know, about a four to six hour day... we're looking in between around the $832 mark and around like the $1,248 mark, that's kind of a standard range for a two bedroom type move.' — Range given and personalized to two-bedroom, reduced crew size per her actual move.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Calvin: 'It is an all inclusive hourly rate. So we wouldn't have any trip fees, as long as you don't move outside of Austin, there's no taxes, there's no credit card fees. All the pads and shrink wrap are included... we do a 2.5 hour minimum. That minimum is $520, once we exceed the minimum, it's just billed in fifteen minute increments...' — Full fee transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Calvin moved directly to: 'But does that all kind of checkout and make sense for what you're looking to move?' No pause for the customer's reaction before continuing.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Calvin: 'also included in our rate is our no worries damage coverage. We allocate up to $2,000 per move. Just to give you peace of mind that any damages are fully covered. We go well above and beyond the 60¢ per pound insurance...' — Fully delivered with no-deductible framing and built-in-to-rate clarity.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Calvin: 'we do have an on time guarantee if you're ever, we're have a late to a window of arrival, we give you we do discount your money back...' — Delivered, though phrasing is slightly garbled ('discount your money back' should clarify immediate discount starts).
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Calvin: 'So, just wanted to mention those items as well as far as questions that you have at the moment regarding any of that, anything I can answer for you?' Customer: 'No, that's perfect thank you.' — Asks confirmation but doesn't explicitly say 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. Confirms lack of remaining questions but not in the prescribed closing language.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Calvin never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or similar. Customer never raised concerns beyond price, so no genuine final check happens.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' present.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Calvin provides pricing, mentions no deposits/fees, and says 'What I can do is, I can email you the pricing and the quote and then yeah, once you kind of have a date lined up... you can give us a callback. evidence_quotes.rate_lock: Calvin: 'we don't have deposits to book or rescheduling or cancellation fees or anything like that so I can get you know, pricing and all of that...' — No deposit / no-fee framework mentioned.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Missing: confirmed arrival window, crew size confirmation for the actual booking, notes left for crew about customer concerns. top_strength: Calvin gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, size, stories, room count, access, special items, box count) and delivered precise, personalized pricing anchored to the customer's specific two-bedroom downsizing situation rather than a generic quote.
coaching_note: Never asked for the business — end the call with a direct 'Would you like our help with your move?' before pivoting to follow-up workflow, and hold silence after the pricing anchor ('Does that feel fair?') to let the customer react first rather than immediately pivoting to next steps.
booking_note: Customer said they would call back once they have a confirmed date and destination: 'I can like come back to you all when I actually have my place so.'
